name: org.openrewrite.apache.commons.configuration.MigrateAbstractConfigurationSubclasses
displayName: Override the methods Commons Configuration 2.x lets `AbstractConfiguration` subclasses override
description: Configuration 2 made `getProperty`, `getKeys`, `isEmpty`, `containsKey`, `containsValue`, `clear`, `clearProperty`, `setProperty`, `addProperty` and `size` of `AbstractConfiguration` final, and has them call protected methods named with an `Internal` or `Direct` suffix, which subclasses override instead. This renames the overrides, unless the class declares the method they are renamed to already, and the calls they make to the superclass's implementation, and adds the `clearPropertyDirect` and `containsValueInternal` methods that 2.x made abstract to classes that extend `AbstractConfiguration` directly: the first does nothing, as it did by default in 1.x, and the second asks the configuration's own keys. This recipe matches the 1.x API by the names the move to the `org.apache.commons.configuration2` package gives it, and is meant to run as part of `UpgradeApacheCommonsConfiguration_1_2`.

name: org.openrewrite.apache.commons.configuration.MigrateFileBasedConfigurations
displayName: Migrate Commons Configuration 1.x file handling to 2.x
description: Configuration 2 creates a file-based configuration with a `FileBasedConfigurationBuilder`, and loads, saves and locates it with a `FileHandler`, where 1.x did all of that in the configuration. This replaces the 1.x constructors that took a file name, `File` or `URL` with a builder, and the `load`, `save` and file location methods with those of a `FileHandler`. A local variable that is saved or asked for its file keeps the builder or `FileHandler` in a variable of its own, so that it is saved where it was loaded from. A subclass constructor that had its superclass load a file loads it with a `FileHandler` of its own. Configurations created from a file, or created empty in a statement of their own, are given a `DefaultListDelimiterHandler(',')`, as 1.x split values at commas by default and 2.x does not. The location of a configuration held in a field is not known where it is used, so a `save()` without arguments, or a question for its file, on a field is left to be migrated by hand, and so is the list delimiter of one created empty in a field's initializer. This recipe matches the 1.x API by the names the move to the `org.apache.commons.configuration2` package gives it, and is meant to run as part of `UpgradeApacheCommonsConfiguration_1_2`.
category1Description: Recipes for [Apache Commons Configuration](https://commons.apache.org/proper/commons-configuration/) migrations.
category2Description: Recipes for [Apache Commons](https://commons.apache.org/) library upgrades and migrations.
category3Description: Recipes to perform [Apache](https://apache.org/) project migration tasks.

name: org.openrewrite.apache.commons.configuration.MigrateHierarchicalConfigurations
displayName: Use the Commons Configuration 2.x hierarchical configuration types
description: Configuration 2 made `HierarchicalConfiguration` a generic interface, which `BaseHierarchicalConfiguration` implements, and returns the sub configurations of `configurationsAt` as `HierarchicalConfiguration<ImmutableNode>`. This creates and extends `BaseHierarchicalConfiguration` where 1.x code created or extended `HierarchicalConfiguration`, and gives `HierarchicalConfiguration` the `ImmutableNode` type argument, which every hierarchical configuration of 2.x has, where variables, methods, casts and type arguments refer to it, as the raw type has none of the generic types of its methods, such as the `List` that `configurationsAt` returns. This recipe matches the 1.x API by the names the move to the `org.apache.commons.configuration2` package gives it, and is meant to run as part of `UpgradeApacheCommonsConfiguration_1_2`.

name: org.openrewrite.apache.commons.configuration.MigrateUntypedListGetters
displayName: Ask Commons Configuration 2.x for lists of the type the code expects
description: Before 1.7, `getList` returned a raw `List`, which code could assign to a `List<String>`. 2.x returns a `List<Object>`, which it can't, so this asks for the element type instead, as in `getList(String.class, key, new ArrayList<>())`, which converts the values to it. displayName: Find modules that exchange Commons Configuration 1.x types with a library
description: Marks the source files of modules that call, override or extend a method or class of a library, a type that is not declared in the sources, whose declaration takes, returns, throws or extends a Commons Configuration 1.x type, such as TinkerPop 3.4's `GraphFactory.open(Configuration)`, Archaius 1's `ConfigurationManager.getConfigInstance()` or Hadoop's `MetricsSink.init(SubsetConfiguration)`. name: org.openrewrite.apache.commons.configuration.UpgradeApacheCommonsConfiguration_1_2
description: Migrate applications from Apache Commons Configuration 1.x to the latest 2.x release. This recipe changes the dependency, moves the `org.apache.commons.configuration` package to `org.apache.commons.configuration2` and the exceptions to its `ex` package, replaces the constructors that loaded a file with a `FileBasedConfigurationBuilder`, moves loading, saving and the file location to a `FileHandler`, replaces the list delimiter methods with a `ListDelimiterHandler`, has subclasses of `AbstractConfiguration` override the `Internal` methods 2.x calls from the methods it made final, and creates and extends `BaseHierarchicalConfiguration` where 1.x code used the `HierarchicalConfiguration` class, which is an interface in 2.x. Configuration 2 no longer splits values at commas by default, so the configurations it creates from a file are given a `DefaultListDelimiterHandler(',')` to keep reading lists as they did. Modules that exchange Configuration 1 types with a library that is still on 1.x, such as TinkerPop 3.4, Archaius 1 or Hadoop's metrics2, are left alone, as their code has to keep using the types that library declares. Reloading strategies, event listeners and hierarchical configuration nodes have no direct replacement, and are left to be migrated by hand.

name: org.openrewrite.apache.commons.configuration.UpgradeCommonsConfiguration2Dependencies
displayName: Upgrade the Commons libraries that Commons Configuration 2.x needs
description: Commons Configuration 2.x needs Commons Lang 3, Text and IO at least as recent as the versions it declares, where 1.x needed none of them, and its builders need a Commons BeanUtils of 1.9 or later. A Maven build resolves an older one instead when it is declared directly, comes from a dependency declared earlier, or is managed by a BOM such as Spring Boot's. Configuration 2 then fails at runtime with a `NoClassDefFoundError` or `NoSuchMethodError` the first time a configuration is created. This upgrades them to the versions that Commons Configuration 2.15.1 declares, in the modules that depend on Commons Configuration 1.x.

name: org.openrewrite.apache.httpclient5.AddTimeUnitArgument
displayName: Adds a TimeUnit argument to the matched method invocations
description: In Apache Http Client 5.x migration, an extra TimeUnit argument is required in the timeout and duration methods. Previously in 4.x, all these methods were implicitly having the timeout or duration expressed in milliseconds, but in 5.x the unit of the timeout or duration is required. So, by default this recipe adds `TimeUnit.MILLISECONDS`, it is possible to specify this as a parameter. Since all affected methods of the Apache Http Client 5.x migration only have one integer/long argument, the recipe applies with matched method invocations of exactly one parameter.

name: org.openrewrite.apache.httpclient5.MigrateHttpStatusConstantsInterface
description: HttpClient 4's `org.apache.http.HttpStatus` is an interface of constants, while HttpClient 5's `org.apache.hc.core5.http.HttpStatus` is a final class. Remove `HttpStatus` from `implements` (and from an interface's `extends`), and qualify the `SC_*` constants that were inherited through it as `HttpStatus.SC_*`.
category2Description: Recipes for migrating to [Apache HttpClient 5.x](https://hc.apache.org/httpcomponents-client-5.4.x/).
category3Description: Recipes to perform [Apache](https://apache.org/) project migration tasks.

name: org.openrewrite.apache.httpclient5.RemoveSettingsIgnoredWithConnectionManager
displayName: Remove `HttpClientBuilder` connection settings ignored next to `setConnectionManager`
description: HttpClient 4's `HttpClientBuilder` applies `setDefaultSocketConfig`, `setDefaultConnectionConfig`, `setMaxConnTotal`, `setMaxConnPerRoute`, `setConnectionTimeToLive` and `setDnsResolver` only to the connection manager it creates itself, so they have no effect when the same builder chain also calls `setConnectionManager`. HttpClient 5's `HttpClientBuilder` no longer has these methods; remove them from such chains.
category2Description: Recipes for migrating to [Apache HttpClient 5.x](https://hc.apache.org/httpcomponents-client-5.4.x/).
category3Description: Recipes to perform [Apache](https://apache.org/) project migration tasks.

name: org.openrewrite.apache.httpclient5.MigrateUrlEncodedFormEntityStringCharset
displayName: Replace `new UrlEncodedFormEntity(List, String)` with `new UrlEncodedFormEntity(Iterable, Charset)`
description: HttpClient 5's `UrlEncodedFormEntity` takes the charset as a `Charset` only. Replace a supported charset name literal with the `StandardCharsets` constant, or with `Charset.forName(..)`, and a `static final` `String` constant declared in the same file with `Charset.forName(CONSTANT)`. Other arguments, which may be `null`, are left for manual migration.
category2Description: Recipes for migrating to [Apache HttpClient 5.x](https://hc.apache.org/httpcomponents-client-5.4.x/).
category3Description: Recipes to perform [Apache](https://apache.org/) project migration tasks.
